abstract:
From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack

Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack Tencent Robotics X × Tencent Hy Team https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fdd1966c-8453-4f6a-9758-238076d08ac4 ## 🔥 Updates * **`[2026-07-09]`** 🤖 Added [RoboDojo](https://github.com/robodojo-benchmark/RoboDojo) benchmark support — including HDF5 dataset loader, training / evaluation scripts, and a policy adapter. Thanks to [XPolicyLab](https://github.com/XPolicyLab/XPolicyLab) for the contribution! * **`[2026-06-16]`** 🌐 Added ModelScope links for all models and data. * **`[2026-06-15]`** 🚀 We have released **Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA** — including the codebase, the [`Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-UMI`](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-UMI) and [`Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-RoboTwin`](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-RoboTwin) models, and the [`Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-Data`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tencent/Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-Data) egocentric UMI dataset (2K+ hours)! ## 📖 Abstract We introduce **Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA (Hy-VLA)** — an end-to-end Vision-Language-Action system that spans the full robot learning stack: data collection, model design, pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. Built on the [Hy-Embodied-0.5](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Embodied) MoT backbone, Hy-VLA integrates a flow-matching action expert, a compact memory encoder for multi-frame history, and a delta-chunk action representation decoupled from embodiment-specific kinematics. Powered by **10,000+ hours** of high-fidelity UMI demonstrations collected via a custom fingertip interface with optical motion-capture, Hy-VLA achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark (**90.9% / 90.1%** on Clean / Randomized) and demonstrates robust cross-embodiment transfer across four real-world robot platforms. Paired with [FlowPRO](https://wuyeyexvnainai.github.io/flowpro/) preference optimization and an asynchronous inference frame

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：基于 Hy-Embodied-0.5 的 MoT 主干构建端到端 VLA 系统：集成 flow-matching 动作专家、压缩式多帧历史记忆编码器，以及与本体运动学解耦的 delta-chunk 动作表示，并配合 FlowPRO 偏好优化（RL 后训练）与异步推理框架，统一打通 10,000+ 小时 UMI 示范数据采集、预训练、SFT、RL 后训练和真机部署全流程。


# 一、动机

> 现有 VLA 工作多只覆盖模型设计或后训练等单一环节，缺少从数据采集、预训练到真机部署的完整机器人学习栈；同时动作表示常与特定本体的运动学耦合，导致跨本体迁移困难、真机鲁棒性不足。


# 二、方法

> 基于 Hy-Embodied-0.5 的 MoT 主干构建端到端 VLA 系统：集成 flow-matching 动作专家、压缩式多帧历史记忆编码器，以及与本体运动学解耦的 delta-chunk 动作表示，并配合 FlowPRO 偏好优化（RL 后训练）与异步推理框架，统一打通 10,000+ 小时 UMI 示范数据采集、预训练、SFT、RL 后训练和真机部署全流程。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得 SOTA，Clean 场景 90.9%、Randomized 场景 90.1%；2) 依托 10,000+ 小时高保真 UMI 示范（经定制指尖接口 + 光学动捕采集），并开源其中 2K+ 小时 egocentric UMI 数据集及 UMI/RoboTwin 两个模型；3) 在四种真实机器人平台上验证了鲁棒的跨本体迁移，并新增 RoboDojo 基准支持（HDF5 数据加载、训练/评测脚本与策略适配器）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：摘要未披露真机任务的成功率、推理延迟等量化指标，UMI 数据依赖定制指尖接口与光学动捕，采集成本与可扩展性受限；异步推理与 FlowPRO 偏好优化对跨本体泛化的独立贡献缺少消融。启发：将动作表示与本体现存运动学解耦（delta-chunk）+ 轻量记忆编码器的设计，对具身策略的跨本体复用和长时序操作有直接参考价值。
